== Site VS Sites ==

"Together Collam Daan and the Sharom were the main site for advanced research" is correct, Sharom is a building, Collam Daan is a campus.  "Together the University of Southern California and Zumberge Hall are the main site for advanced Trojan learning" would be a similar situation.  If you are still unhappy with the phrasing go ahead and reword the sentence to something like "Collam Daan and specificaly the Sharom was the main site..." but the two together are one site. --[[User:Melriken|Melriken]] 18:49, 7 February 2008 (UTC)
